name: Gamma Strategies Ramses Clearing single-sided deposit ratio-check bypass
summary: The Ramses-specific Gamma Clearing v1.2.3 at 0xcfb851b1b1345fe6c643e71f98b36ad887fa7db6 contains the same unsafe getDepositAmount exception as Gamma's other Clearing deployments: whenever the vault totalSupply is zero or either getTotalAmounts component is zero, it accepts any ratio up to the per-token deposit maximum instead of enforcing the configured ratio band. The attacker manipulated the Ramses USDC-USDC.e pool until its concentrated-liquidity vault was single-sided, passed highly imbalanced deposits through Ramses UniProxy 0x564f9d9df1d8baa1a8202a38ef0a18600b127b7e and this Clearing, received shares priced at the manipulated spot price, restored the pool and redeemed disproportionate shares. Gamma's later security review identifies this single-sided ratio-check exception as the root cause.
notes: Ramses Clearing v1.2.3 is a plain non-upgradeable contract deployed directly by Gamma deployer 0x71e7d05be74ff748c45402c06a941c822d756dc5 in transaction 0x30d74c827c99facf7bf27e5634c052d2a421368c5fcc092624d8ead8496eaa58 at Arbitrum block 105238473. The account is empty at block 105238472, and runtime hash 0x89bfcde972bb307625f1260a630bdcc77fdec5232b798632efd3d98e22a250a1 is identical at the deployment block, block 136056012 and block 166873552 immediately before the anchor. The EIP-1967 implementation slot is zero at block 166873552 and the verified runtime exposes no upgrade mechanism, so deployment is the only executable-code change. Mutable thresholds and per-vault settings are configuration context rather than the code-age basis.

Gamma's project post-mortem assigns approximately $1.313M to the USDC-USDC.e Ramses vault 0x80709a760ff54112bd3e0ce31c104d912ba51774. This record includes only that vault's repeated campaign through Ramses Clearing 0xcfb851b1b1345fe6c643e71f98b36ad887fa7db6 and excludes the separately recorded gDAI-DAI and Camelot vault losses through two other Clearing deployments. Gamma marks the figure as approximate and does not publish an exact asset-level decomposition or valuation method, so the reported point estimate is medium confidence. The successful transactions in source-5 delimit the included campaign; no recovery is netted out.
USD loss is Gamma's approximate per-vault reported figure; no exact asset-level decomposition was published.

This record covers only the USDC-USDC.e Ramses vault gated by Clearing 0xcfb851b1b1345fe6c643e71f98b36ad887fa7db6. The gDAI-DAI and Camelot legs have their own independently aged Clearing records and disjoint losses.
